verdict.rationale: xAI documents hosting its own official MCP server (docs-mcp) that lets AI assistants/agents connect and access xAI documentation, and this is corroborated by a probe confirming the page's existence — this is genuine first-party server-side MCP support, not just client-side tool calling. However the documented server is narrowly scoped to documentation retrieval rather than a general-purpose agent/tool-exposure server. Missing for 10: evidence of a broader official MCP server exposing Grok's own model/tool capabilities to external agents, and independent/community confirmation of real-world usage.
